items.text: Check whether JAPAN eVISA covers your trip (it is for single-entry tourism)
Check where to apply: purposes other than tourism are applied for through the Embassy, a Consulate or an accredited agency
Original Indian passport, valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay, with at least 2 blank pages
Visa application form, filled in and signed (the signature must match your passport)
2 identical photos, 2 × 2 inches (50 × 50 mm), taken within the last 6 months: plain white background, matte finish, face covering 70–80% of the photo
Round-trip flight booking (confirmed or tentative) showing your entry to and exit from Japan
Confirmed hotel bookings covering every night of your stay
Bank statements for the last 6 months: original, stamped and signed by the bank, showing steady transactions without sudden large deposits
Income tax returns (ITR-V) for the last 1–2 assessment years, with Form 16 or the computation of income
Letter on your company letterhead, signed, stating your designation, joining date, approved leave dates and salary
Business owners: GST registration
Proof that you are a student, such as a student ID or a letter from your institution
If a family member is paying: a signed sponsorship letter, the sponsor's bank statements and proof of your relationship
Schedule of Stay (Taizai Nitteihyo): for each day, the date, activities, accommodation name, address and phone number. You can make a draft from your Mitra Japan plan.
Cover letter to the Embassy or Consulate explaining why you are travelling and who is travelling with you
Documents about the business visit, such as a letter from the company in Japan and from your own company
Documents from the person you are visiting in Japan, such as an invitation letter and proof of your relationship

rows.label: Who it is for
rows.evisa: Indian nationals living in India, arriving by air for tourism
rows.single: Indian passport holders applying at a physical centre
rows.multiple: Travellers with high economic capability or travel history to G7 nations

rows.label: How you apply
rows.evisa: Online through the MOFA eVISA website
rows.single: In person or through a representative at VFS Global

items.label: Suggested liquid balance
items.text: ₹2,50,000 to ₹3,50,000 per person for a 7–10 day visit

items.label: Income tax returns
items.text: Consistent annual taxable income, ideally above ₹5,00,000 a year

items.label: If someone sponsors you
items.text: A signed sponsorship letter, the sponsor's bank statements and proof of your relationship

jurisdictions.note: Apply where you live, shown by Aadhaar, a lease agreement or a utility bill.

offices.name: Consulate-General of Japan, Mumbai
states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

items.title: Unexplained lump-sum deposits
items.text: Large, sudden deposits just before you print your statements often attract extra scrutiny. Savings that build up steadily are easier to explain.

items.title: Dates that don't match
items.text: Your flight dates, hotel vouchers and Schedule of Stay should all show the same dates.

items.title: Vague itinerary entries
items.text: Entries like 'Day 2: Tokyo sightseeing' without specific places, hotels and phone numbers can cause delays.
